blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Most of the Visayas will experience cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms on Sunday, September 27, due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ), the state weather bureau said. In its daily forecast, the Visayas Pagasa Regional Services Division (PRSD) said rainy weather will affect the Negros Island Region, Central Visayas, […]...
